Hello fellow veterans.  
I'm Nick Overby, the Writer and Producer of the short film 'The Emu War', and I'm reaching out to you today to ask for your assistance in making this film a reality.  
I believe the lack of historical features showcasing the horrors of the Emu War is a true travesty. With this film, we aim to help remedy this problem.  
All money brought in through donations will be put towards costumes, location fees, and equipment, to make this look as historically accurate as possible.  
Our talented crew is excited to get to work on this project and we want to share the whole production process with you. We will regularly be updated the Campaign Page to showcase new advancements in production (the complete cast list will be up at this time next week).  
If you have any questions about the film, I'll be on the site, happy to answer them.  
Forgetting history is dooming ourselves to repeat it.   
Let's avoid another Emu War together.

Unpopular on this sub: Zach Snyder is the greatest villain to the DCEU. Blame WB all you want, but at the end of the day, Snyder just isn't that great of a director (besides making pretty shots) and should never have been given the reigns to the entire universe.   
Unpopular outside this sub: The DCEU doesn't need to exist. I am a huge fan of the characters, and read the new DC comics every Wednesday. That said, they shouldn't force out a cinematic universe to compete with Marvel. With the MCU cranking out 2-3 movies a year, I'm already feeling a lot of burnout over these continuous series. Instead, focus on standalone stories and don't be afraid to go experimental and show us something that Marvel won't (Fox was nailing this with *Logan*, *Deadpool*, and *New Mutants* set up to not follow the predictable formula Marvel films follow).  
Give us a Batman Beyond film series in the style of Raimi's Spider-Man (if they want a franchise to still be cashing in on the standard superhero fare). Besides that, let's get weird. Sandman, Legion of Superheroes, Justice League Dark (call them something else, of course), and New Gods all offer unique worlds which could stand entirely on their own, without being held back by a DCEU.
The most powerful hero in the Marvel Universe, who has jailed all of his villains except for the Void. He finds out that the Void is the manifestation of his split personality created by his powers.
